authorization.scope: two adjacent FDA-published non-cumulative FAERS ASCII quarters, inspected ephemerally for real case-version chains and aggregate-only capacity
authorization.basis: same FDA public-source, website-policy, openFDA CC0, and narrative-withholding evidence frozen in the P35 source register; no formal legal opinion

research_question: Do adjacent non-cumulative FAERS quarters contain enough real repeated-case version chains to support a privacy-bounded latest-at-cutoff plus multi-table reconciliation task at exact 32K/64K/128K lengths?
constraints: the output is latest-at-cutoff version selection, paired primaryid/caseid FK reconciliation, and raw/stale/latest/control totals only
medical causality, incidence, prevalence, comparative safety, risk ranking, and clinical advice are prohibited
only cases observed in both adjacent quarters with a strictly increasing caseversion count toward version-chain capacity
case identifiers, hashes of case identifiers, raw clinical terms, demographics, detailed dates, dose/lot data, and reporter/manufacturer identifiers never enter reports or training text
version-chain capacity excludes unrelated one-version cases and surrogate identifiers
no generation before active/deleted-case semantics, privacy release, formal near-dup, exact-band, remove-one, and 4K/8K/16K shortcut gates pass unchanged
